_readme: Named column layouts, for when auto-detection gets a file wrong.
Column indexes are 0-based positions in the CSV. 'description' may be a
single index or a list of indexes to join. Set 'outflow_is_negative' to
false when the file writes money out as a positive number in a single
amount column. Set 'dayfirst' to false for month-first dates.
IMPORTANT: the entries below are illustrative SHAPES, not verified copies
of any bank's current export format. Bank exports change without notice.
Open your own file, count the columns, and confirm before trusting one.
Auto-detection handles most files correctly and additionally verifies its
sign inference against the running balance, so try it with no profile

split_description_no_balance.name: Date, Reference, Details, Amount - month-first dates

outflows_written_positive.name: Payments-only export where money out is a positive number

with_posted_date_and_card.name: Transaction date, posted date, description, amount, balance, card
